text: The 'Modernization and Densification of National Seismic Monitoring Infrastructure' is a comprehensive initiative under China's 14th Five-Year Plan aimed at enhancing earthquake preparedness and disaster reduction. Led by the China Earthquake Administration, the initiative focuses on constructing and digitalizing the China Earthquake Early Warning Network, expanding fault investigations, conducting nationwide risk surveys, and implementing a three-year 'earthquake informationization' action plan to improve data integration and service delivery.
